baseTasks.title: Sow pre-germinated seeds in nursery bed
baseTasks.details: Use certified seeds; maintain a thin water film in the nursery bed.

baseTasks.title: Apply first light irrigation and check for seedling health
baseTasks.details: Watch for early pest/fungal issues in the nursery.

baseTasks.title: Transplant seedlings to main field
baseTasks.details: Maintain 20x15 cm spacing; transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill.

baseTasks.title: Apply first dose of nitrogen fertilizer
baseTasks.details: Split nitrogen dose as per soil-adjusted guidance.

baseTasks.title: Check water level and weed the field
baseTasks.details: Maintain 2-3 cm standing water; remove weeds manually or with recommended herbicide.

baseTasks.title: Monitor for stem borer and leaf folder pests
baseTasks.details: Inspect leaves for early pest damage signs.

baseTasks.title: Apply second dose of fertilizer (panicle initiation stage)
baseTasks.details: Critical stage for yield - do not delay this application.

baseTasks.title: Maintain consistent water level, avoid water stress
baseTasks.details: Water stress at this stage significantly reduces yield.

baseTasks.title: Monitor for neck blast and sheath rot disease
baseTasks.details: High humidity increases disease risk during flowering.

baseTasks.title: Ensure adequate water - flowering is highly water-sensitive
baseTasks.details: Avoid draining the field during this window.

baseTasks.title: Drain field water gradually ahead of harvest
baseTasks.details: Stop irrigation about 10 days before expected harvest.

baseTasks.title: Check grain maturity and plan harvest
baseTasks.details: Harvest when 80-85% of grains have turned golden yellow.

baseTasks.title: Check nearby mandi prices before selling
baseTasks.details: Use the market advisory feature to decide optimal selling time/location.

clay.irrigationNote: Clay soil retains water longer - reduce irrigation frequency, watch for waterlogging.
clay.fertilizerNote: Standard fertilizer dose is sufficient; ensure field drains before fertilizer application.

loamy.irrigationNote: Loamy soil - follow standard baseline irrigation schedule.
loamy.fertilizerNote: Standard fertilizer dose as per baseline calendar.

sandy.irrigationNote: Sandy soil drains fast - irrigate more frequently to avoid moisture stress.
sandy.fertilizerNote: Split fertilizer into smaller, more frequent doses since nutrients leach faster.
